lines.en: My hands smell of iron.
I walk along the mining tunnel.
I step surely, like an old miner.
I skirt a heap of slag.

lines.zh: 我朝有敲击声的方向去。
lines.en: I head toward the knocking.
I carry a bundle of iron bars.
I kick at a stone.
I brush along the cave wall.
I hold my hem so it does not snag.
I climb step by step.
I look back once.
I walk toward the light.
I stop by the stone bridge.
I shift the bars to the other shoulder.
I shuffle out of the cave mouth.
I crouch by the iron ore.
I scratch the stone with a nail.
I am judging the ore.
I count the bars one by one.
Water drips in the cave.
I rest a hand on the rock.
I wait for the forge to heat.
I sniff the rust.
I roll up my sleeve.
I dig the dirt from under my nail.
I wipe the bars again.

lines.zh: 我在想这一块能打几把刀。
lines.en: I wonder how many blades this piece would make.
I sit with my back to the wall.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，灰都飞起来。
lines.en: I cough and dust lifts.
I look up at you with a frown.
You are blocking my shaft.
This iron is mine.
Are you here to dig too?
We have not seen you in our cave.
I shift back a little.
I grip the bars tighter.
You need to back out.
I look at your hands.

lines.zh: 我抬头又低头，像在算什么。
lines.en: I look up and down as if calculating.
Do you have iron? If not, go.
I grunt.
I retreat to the wall.
One bar falls.
I bare my teeth.
I pick up the bar.
I have taken worse.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，矿道里没处躲。
lines.en: I'll remember you; there's nowhere to hide in these tunnels.

lines.zh: 铁片挡得住刀，挡不住疼。
lines.en: Iron stops the blade but not the ache.
What will you trade?
Iron would do as well.
I bite it; it is soft.
I am not impressed.

lines.zh: 就这点？我矿里的铁不止这个价。
lines.en: That's it? My iron is worth more.
That is not enough for a chunk of ore.
I will keep it.
Do not fob me off with that.
What you hold is not bad.
Put it down and step back a pace.
Let me see inside.
Too heavy; you carry it.
I know cave iron when I see it.
Bring iron next time.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，铁条掉了两根。
lines.en: You knock into me and two bars fall.
I bend to pick them up.
You stepped on my hand.

lines.zh: 我贴着矿壁让开半个身位。
lines.en: I press to the tunnel wall and yield half a step.
My shoulder hits the wall.
The impact is dull and heavy.
I brace against the wall.
I bare my teeth and say nothing.
My bars roll away.
Do not shove; I am loaded.
There is a whole clan in the cave.
She runs the forge.
I give her the best iron.
Her hammer blows land true.
We eat by the forge.
Sparks fly at our faces.
She says I dig too deep.
I say it is iron all the same.
The forge never goes out.
At dawn we go back to hammering.
I bend and pick up the stone.
This one is iron.
I weigh it.
I put it in my back sack.
The raw iron in this cave is mine first.
I bite it.
I take two pieces.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看了看，又放下。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and set it down.
This is enough for a small blade.
You dropped it? I will keep it.
You took my iron.
I set the bars down.
The entrance is blocked.

lines.zh: 我把背上的铁条抽了出来。
lines.en: I pull the iron bar off my back.

lines.zh: 这一下我把铁条抡圆了。
lines.en: This swing, I put the whole iron bar into.
I clench my fist.

lines.zh: 我朝矿道深处吼了一嗓子。
lines.en: I bellow down the tunnel.
Everyone in the cave heard.
You will not walk out.
I follow along the wall.
The echoes help me.
You are going deeper.
I have walked this tunnel for decades.
I kick a stone aside.
There is a drop ahead.
Sparks jump from my hand.
Through the rock crack, to your flank.

lines.zh: 矿道里的回声把你的脚步送来了。
lines.en: The tunnel echo carries your steps to me.
I swing an iron bar at you.
I butt your knee.
I ram into your chest.
I put everything into that.
You fall back into the wall.
My knuckles are scraped.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下来的，是粗铁。
lines.en: What falls off me is raw iron.
I push you toward the drop.
You did not fall.
I crawl out of the iron seam.
My hands are still red with earth.
I cut this tunnel.
The fire in the cave lights me.
I wedge my pick in a crack.
I lift my head and smell a stranger.
I stand and ash falls off me.
All the iron on this level is ours.
I weigh the bars in my hand.
I walk slowly toward the entrance.

lines.zh: 炉火燎到我，我甩着胳膊。
lines.en: Forge fire catches me and I shake my arm.

lines.zh: 我从石桥掉下去，摔在矿车上。
lines.en: I fall off the bridge onto a mine cart.

lines.zh: 地下水涌上来，我死命往上游。
lines.en: Groundwater surges and I fight to the surface.
The blast caves in half the tunnel.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩里，铁锈混着血。
lines.en: The arrow bites my shoulder; rust mixes with blood.
Spell-light bursts against my face.
Too hungry to carry the bars.
Thunder rolls down the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，铁条也带不走。
lines.en: I fall into the void, and even the bars are lost.
